note: Daemon RPC surface ceiling. maxMethodsPerDomain is the structural cap: a domain that outgrows it must be split. maxTotalMethods is the hard ceiling on the whole socket RPC surface (196 live; one strangler wave of headroom). maxActorBoundMethods and actorBoundDomains freeze the methods still served on the BurnBarDaemonServer actor: they may only shrink, so new methods land in an isolated domain handler (OpenBurnBarDaemon/Sources/OpenBurnBarDaemon/RPC/Domains/). Enforced by scripts/debt/check-rpc-domain-ceiling.sh.
